C, title XXXI, § 3146(c)(5), Dec. 26, 2013, 127 Stat. 1074; Pub. L. 115–232, div. C, title XXXI, § 3111(c), Aug. 13, 2018, 132 Stat. 2289; Pub. L. 117–263, div. notes.heading: Development of Low-Yield Nuclear Weapons; Authorization and Limitation
notes.text: Pub. L. 115–232, div. C, title XXXI, § 3111(a), Aug. 13, 2018, 132 Stat. 2289, which authorized the Secretary of Energy to carry out engineering development and subsequent phases to modify or develop a low-yield nuclear warhead for submarine-launched ballistic missiles, was transferred and is set out as a note under section 6120 of Title 10, Armed Forces. Pub. L. 108–136, div. C, title XXXI, § 3116(c), Nov. 24, 2003, 117 Stat. 1746, as amended by Pub. L. 115–232, div. C, title XXXI, § 3111(b), Aug. 13, 2018, 132 Stat. 2289, which prohibited commencement of engineering development or subsequent phases of of a low-yield nuclear weapon without a specific funding request, was transferred and is set out as a note under section 6120 of Title 10, Armed Forces.
